description:
This repository provides a V binding for webview, a cross-platform library for building desktop applications with native web views.

Maintained by Pushpak Jaiswal (pushpakmjaiswal@gmail.com). This is a community-maintained continuation of ttytm/webview. The original project and its contributors remain credited; this repository carries forward the V compatibility, packaging, and platform-build updates described here.

The upstream C++ implementation is pinned in UPSTREAM_WEBVIEW_VERSION. A scheduled GitHub Actions workflow checks upstream tags and opens a pull request with updated source for review.
name: PUSHPAK-JAISWAL.webview
